label: F-03
title: The contract-header NatSpec justifies the unbacked mint with a redemption symmetry that does not exist, and states a 2x output the code does not guarantee
fingerprintNote: sha256(contract:function:rootCauseClass)[:16] - legacy form, empty entryPoint. Carried verbatim from sanitized.json; reproduces from fingerprintBasis.

classification.assetImpact: No direct impact; misleads integrators and reviewers about the collateral position. The contract-header NatSpec (:16-18) justifies the unbacked mint with a redemption symmetry that does not exist and states a flat 2x output the code does not guarantee (the total is exchangeRate-dependent).
attackPath: 1. An integrator or reviewer reads :13-20 and concludes both halves of the payout are redemptions of deposited value.
2. Only the stablecoin half is a redemption; the antimatter half is an uncollateralised mint (M-02).
3. The stated 2x is also not guaranteed - it is (1 + exchangeRate/1e18) (M-04).
classification.likelihood: Certain to mislead any reader who relies on it.

justification: Spec-conformance F-03 at Low. Kept DELIBERATELY SEPARATE from M-02 and NOT folded into it: the root cause is a documentation defect, the remediation is different (correct the NatSpec, not bound the emission), the reader is different (integrators), and - decisively - collapsing it would let the doc defect vanish the moment the economic finding is triaged as accepted-by-design. That separation is the whole point. Consistent with the standing rule that in-source docs carry no suppression authority and, where falsely exhaustive, raise severity rather than lower it: this NatSpec is the ONLY intent artefact this project has (no story, no storyDir), and it is economically inaccurate - which is why M-02's 'it is intended' defence gets no weight.
recommendation: Correct :16-18: only the stablecoin half is a redemption; the antimatter half is an uncollateralised mint. State the exchangeRate dependence of the total rather than a flat 2x.

sanitizer.reason: No known-issues document exists for this project (knownIssuesFile/Source null, knownIssues empty, verified at HEAD) so KI suppression has no authority; no C4 known-invalid class genuinely applies; not a malicious-owner vector; ledger empty so no prior entry to reconcile against.

additionalContext.specText: 'brought together with an equal quantity of a supported stablecoin it annihilates, and the pair is emitted as phUSD - twice the quantity, since both halves are redeemed.' (src/Antimatter.sol:16-18)
additionalContext.deviation: Both clauses are false. (a) 'both halves are redeemed': phUSD has no redemption path anywhere in any repo. The stable leg's phUSD is minted against a real deposit forwarded to a yield strategy; the antimatter leg's phUSD is minted at :236 with no asset entering the protocol - antimatter is itself an unbacked staking reward minted freely at :179. The word 'redeemed' imports a backing that does not exist. (b) 'twice the quantity': the total is amount + mintedForStable, where mintedForStable honours exchangeRate. The repo's own passing test test_annihilateHonoursMinterExchangeRate (test/Annihilation.t.sol:108-117) asserts 195 phUSD for 100 antimatter at a 0.95 rate - the header's headline arithmetic is contradicted by the project's own test.
additionalContext.whyItRaisesRatherThanLowersSeverity: Standing rule: in-source NatSpec carries no suppression authority, and a falsely-authoritative doc raises rather than lowers severity. An integrator reading :13-20 would conclude both phUSD legs are asset-backed. It is also the ONLY intent artefact in the repo (no story is resolvable - PARK-002), so a reader calibrating emission policy has nothing else to go on.
additionalContext.doesNotDampen: The economic impact of the unbacked mint itself is DEDUP-004's to size and is NOT reduced by filing this entry.

mergeAction: KEPT SEPARATE from DEDUP-004 - the explicit justification is recorded in DEDUP-004.econFaithMergeJustification. In short: different root cause (a documentation defect), different remediation (correct the NatSpec at :18), different affected reader (integrators), and if DEDUP-004 is ever triaged as accepted-by-design the doc defect must NOT vanish with it. ECON-001's documentationVsImplementation block is the same observation and is merged INTO this entry rather than left duplicated in DEDUP-004.
